sources.supportingExcerpt: Chinese citizens holding PRC passports, including Hong Kong and Macao SAR, qualify for a temporary visa exemption.

policies.title: Cambodia: named ASEAN ordinary passports visa-exempt
policies.summary: Cambodia’s current official eVisa tourist information expressly lists these nationalities in its visa-exemption cohort.
conditions: The official eVisa information names this visa-exemption cohort but does not state a common stay period. Current bilateral and arrival-service material contains nationality-specific duration data; confirm the applicable duration and entry conditions with Immigration before travel.

This is an ordinary-passport visitor finding only. It does not determine work, residence, extensions, repeated entries, transit, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, alien or other special-document treatment.

Cambodia e-Arrival is an immigration, health and customs declaration. It is not an ETA or visa and does not turn this visa-free policy into an ETA. The current eVisa page calls it required, while GDI says it can be submitted within seven days before or on arrival.
Admission, passport validity, available ports, public-health, security and immigration-officer assessment remain separate requirements.

policies.title: Cambodia: temporary PRC, HKSAR and Macao tourist visa exemption
policies.summary: The current official eVisa announcement temporarily exempts PRC, HKSAR and Macao passport holders from Tourist Visa T for stays up to 14 days.
conditions: The announcement applies to Chinese citizens holding PRC passports, including Hong Kong and Macao SAR passports, regardless of departure point; it permits multiple entries of up to 14 days each in the stated period.
The exemption concerns Tourist Visa T only. It does not establish work, residence, ordinary/business Visa E, transit, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, alien or other special-document rights.
Cambodia e-Arrival remains an arrival declaration, not an ETA or visa; the official temporary-exemption notice requires its completion before entry.
This time-limited measure expires after 15 October 2026 unless Cambodia officially extends or replaces it. Admission remains discretionary.
